versos.texto_bv: Então instigaram alguns homens para que dissessem: “Nós o ouvimos falar palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e contra Deus.”
versos.traducao_literal: Então instigaram homens, dizendo: “Temos ouvido a ele falando palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e contra Deus”;
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): As três referências (NTLH, ARA, NVIPT) convergem em “subornaram” para o grego ὑπέβαλον (ὑποβάλλω), que carrega o sentido de subornar/contratar com pagamento. A BV usa “instigaram”, que significa induzir/incitar sem a conotação de pagamento, perdendo a dimensão de corrupção do falso testemunho. — evidência: NTLH: “pagaram algumas pessoas”; ARA: “subornaram uns homens”; NVIPT: “subornaram alguns homens”. Grego ὑπέβαλον = subornar, contratar secretamente. “Instigar” é semanticamente mais fraco.

kjv.texto: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

vizinhos.10: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
vizinhos.12: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

web.texto: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

vizinhos.10: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
vizinhos.12: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,
